messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: P1 runtime-oom-fragmentation on prod-rt-us-east-1 at 2026-03-17T02:04:00Z. Symptoms: elevated OOMs, page faults spiking, customer 5xx reports. Oncall: @lee-oncall
lee-oncall: I'm on. grabbing node-level logs and nv-smi dumps now. marking channel as incident
sara-ops: I'll join the customer call in 5m, Zoe is queued for updates. any known blast radius? :eyes:
jamie-sre: seeing p95 latency up ~2.8x and a burst of GPU page faults across a subset of nodes. linking traces: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/abc123 (raw)
matt-runtime: putting quick telemetry snippet here — looks like kvcache growth correlated with model-context extension. full dump in 2m.
nora-ml: model traffic note: a few customers started streaming long contexts (>=32k tokens) around 02:00 which matches the tail. Might be KV cache churn.
lee-oncall: nv-smi snapshot pasted:
```
GPU0: total 24576MiB, used 23640MiB, free 936MiB, page_faults=1620, kv_swap=1.4GiB
GPU1: total 24576MiB, used 24456MiB, free 120MiB, page_faults=4985, kv_swap=3.8GiB
```
jamie-sre: host dmesg snippet showing repeated page reclaim logs: `gpu_page_fault: reclaim fallback after kv-alloc fail` — attaching full logs to s3://incidents/1768300000/logs.txt
sara-ops: customer impact: Alex (account) reported 502s on inference endpoint /v1/chat between 02:03-02:18; about 12% error rate for their traffic. on the call now, sharing that we're triaging.
zoe-support: I relayed initial mitigation steps to Alex: scaled down request concurrency client-side and retried; they saw drop in errors. request to keep them updated.
matt-runtime: hypothesizing two things: 1) KV cache hot growth from long-context streaming + no eviction pressure, 2) large batch sizes + fragmentation causing allocator slabs to fail. quick mitigation: clamp per-request kv growth and reduce batch_size to 8 on a subset of nodes.
lee-oncall: preparing hotfix: runtime config patch to set `per_request_kv_limit=1GiB` and `batch_size_max=8` for prod-rt pool. will roll canary to 3 nodes first.
jamie-sre: timeline working draft:
- 02:00 UTC - spike in long-context requests starts
- 02:02 UTC - p95 latency increases on prod-rt-us-east-1
- 02:04 UTC - pager (OOM/page faults)
- 02:06 UTC - first mitigation: reduced client concurrency via support playbook
- 02:10 UTC - runtime patch rolled to 3 canary hosts
- 02:20 UTC - errors drop for canary customers, overall stabilizing
- 02:25 UTC - patch rolled to remaining nodes
- 02:40 UTC - monitoring shows p95 back under SLA
(asking @lee-oncall to confirm timestamps against logs)
lee-oncall: confirmed. attaching per-node memstats CSV: s3://incidents/1768300000/node-mem.csv
sara-ops: oncall to customer: Alex says reduced errors but wants an RCA and whether this will recur. flagged as high priority.
nora-ml: adding ML-side hypothesis: model serving path keeps older context segments pinned in kvcache when streaming completions with partial attention windows. We should add eviction by prefix age.
matt-runtime: executed canary command: `redwoodctl runtime set --pool prod-rt --label canary --set per_request_kv_limit=1Gi --set batch_size_max=8` — rollout logs: https://deploys.internal/1768300000
incident-bot: Deploy started by matt-runtime at 2026-03-17T02:10:48Z, status: rolling -> 3/3 canary OK -> promote-> success
jamie-sre: immediate metric checks: GPU1 page_faults down 70% on canaries, kv_swap reduced by ~60%.
lee-oncall: handing off active RCA to @jamie-sre for post-incident writeup. I'll keep an eye on the customer thread. final action items:
- jamie-sre: compile timeline + attach nv-smi + dmesg + per-request traces (deadline EOD)
- matt-runtime: PR to change default per-request kv limit and add telemetry for per-request kv growth
- nora-ml: run a simulation with 32k token streams to validate eviction heuristic
- sara-ops/zoe-support: follow up with Alex with current mitigations + ETA for RCA
zoe-support: noted, I'll schedule a follow-up call for 02:00 PST tomorrow and include the mitigation summary.
alex-customer: Thanks for the quick response team — appreciate the transparency. We'll hold off on heavy long-context tests until the RCA is in.
jamie-sre: adding initial hypotheses to thread for the RCA doc: [H1] KV cache growth from long-context streaming + missing TTL eviction causing persistent pinned pages; [H2] Large batch_size + allocator fragmentation led to OOM despite nominal free mem; [H3] Edge case in kv_swap path causing delayed reclamation under peak load. will test and rank.
lee-oncall: closing live incident channel in 30m, keeping logs available. assigning jira RED-INC-176830 for final RCA. :thumbsup:
